title: Backup and restore
intro: A backup holds all workflows with their versions, agent templates, tools, knowledge files, memory, runs and settings in one ZIP file.
noKey: For security no API keys of the AI providers are written into a backup. Restoring keeps the keys configured on this computer.
localText: Before every restore Nodestro automatically saves a backup of the previous state.
valid: “{{name}}” is a valid backup from {{date}}. All files are complete and undamaged.

notes.other_version: The backup comes from another Nodestro version. It is taken over on restore; check your workflows briefly afterwards.

replaceWarning: Restoring replaces all current data with the state of the backup.
safetyNote: The current state is backed up automatically first; afterwards you find it in the list of safety backups.
confirm: I understand that my current data will be replaced.
restored: Backup restored. The previous state is in “{{name}}”. The page reloads.

reenter.text: A backup never holds keys, tokens or passwords. Enter these again where they are used; until then, whatever needs them does not work.

data.title: Export and delete data
data.intro: Take all your data with you as readable files, or delete everything on this computer.
data.exportNote: The export is a ZIP file of readable files (workflows, runs, agent templates, tools, knowledge, memory, conversations and settings), without keys, tokens or other secrets. It cannot be restored; use a backup for that.
data.deleteWarning: This deletes every workflow, run, agent template, tool, knowledge file, memory, conversation, setting and secret on this computer.
data.deleteNoBackup: No safety backup is kept. Download a backup or an export first if you want to keep anything.
data.deleteRuns: It only starts while nothing is running, and no run can start while it deletes.
data.deleted: Everything was deleted. This installation now starts over like a new one.
data.deletedPartly_one: Almost everything was deleted, but {{count}} entry could not be removed (for example a file in use). Delete again to remove the rest.
data.deletedPartly_other: Almost everything was deleted, but {{count}} entries could not be removed (for example files in use). Delete again to remove the rest.
